title: Chapter 143 Becoming A Sword God
content:
Chapter 143 Becoming A Sword God

Patriarch!

Hearing the word "Patriarch", Shi Chen was shocked.

At this moment, a trace of fear appeared in Shi Chen's eyes.

After a moment of silence, Shi Chen looked at the star field behind him unwillingly, and then turned and left.

His heart told him.

The orders of the patriarch must not be disobeyed.

And not long after he left, several figures suddenly appeared at the original place.

Feeling the breath left in the void, several people looked extremely fearful.

"Go back and report to His Majesty!"

"They are coming."

.........

Another star field.

This is the most special star field in the known star field.

It is also the most mysterious star field.

The Death Star Field.

It is also called the Dark Star Field by the world.

Rumor has it that there is an extremely terrifying strong man in the Death Star Field.

He single-handedly shaped the current Death Star Field.

And in such a star field that is extremely feared by the world, a touching scene is happening at this moment.

"Wuwuwu, you, you really won't go with me?"

The Dark Emperor pulled a young man's arm, choking with sobs, his eyes full of reluctance.

If this scene was known to the people in the upper world, they would be extremely shocked.

And that young man was none other than Kong who was thrown here by Lu Daosheng.

At this time, Kong's face looked a little ugly.

"Senior An, I have said many times that I have a mission to stay here."

Hearing this, the Dark Emperor immediately waved his hand and said: "Humph, your city lord has already gone to the upper world, and you are still stupid here, are you really stupid or pretending to be stupid?"

Kong closed his eyes, was silent for a long time, and slowly said: "The city lord has indeed left, but he never said that I should go to the upper world now."

"Senior An, you should go by yourself. I will leave when I receive the order from the city lord."

Looking at Kong's soft and hard look, the Dark Emperor sighed, a little helpless.

This guy is really stubborn.

At the same time, he was somewhat envious of Lu Daosheng, who could actually meet such a talent.

But he had no other choice, because he couldn't beat him.

"Forget it, since you have made up your mind, then you stay here first. When you go to the upper realm, don't forget to come to me."

Then the Dark Emperor took out a talisman and threw it to Kong.

"Oh, by the way, there is one more thing. Your city lord has left, but his wife is still here. Now, his wife is in trouble. You decide what to do."

After saying that, the Dark Emperor trembled and disappeared completely here.

Although he knew Yan Lingyun, the relationship was average. Unless Yan Lingyun came to him for help, he would not take the initiative to help.

And now, he was leaving, and he had nothing to do.

Hearing the Dark Emperor's words, Kong slowly opened his eyes.

Suddenly, a terrifying breath rushed out.

In just a moment, the entire Death Star Domain trembled wildly.

It was above the Super God Realm!

There is no time for cultivation, and soon, ten thousand years have passed.

In these ten thousand years, the whole world has not seen any major changes, and it is still the same as before.

However, there is an uneasy atmosphere coming from many unknown borders.

In these ten thousand years, except for issuing some orders, Yan Lingyun, the empress of the Divine Dynasty, has been in seclusion for the rest of the time.

And the Divine Dynasty also formally formed an alliance with the Desolate City.

This news shocked countless star regions at the time.

Except for the Desolate City, almost everyone thought that the two behemoths would inevitably fight.

After all, there is no room for two tigers in one mountain!

It’s a pity that they didn’t think of the following sentence.

The alliance of these two forces also gave many strong people some opportunities to develop.

Especially the Desolate City, the strength has increased extremely fast, which shocked countless strong people in the Divine Dynasty.

It’s okay to have a super-god realm martial god.

There is actually a sword god.

It’s okay to have a sword god, but there is actually a war god behind it!

And now, everyone is gathered in the City Lord’s Mansion of the Desolate City.

Among them, there are not only the strong men from the Wasteland City, but also many strong men from the Divine Dynasty.

After the two forces formed an alliance, their relationship was inexplicably very good.

Of course, many of these were due to the efforts of the Wasteland City.

Although Yan Lingyun had already issued an order, the people below were a little wary of the Wasteland City at the beginning.

Unexpectedly, the people in the Wasteland City were particularly enthusiastic. They not only invited them to visit the Wasteland City, but also took out a lot of precious resources.

Faced with these, how could the strong men of the Divine Dynasty refuse?

Not long after, the two forces completely fought each other.

"Can it succeed?"

Looking at a certain place in the City Lord's Mansion, Gu Chen said solemnly.

On the side, An Xing nodded, "I believe in Wei Ge, he will definitely succeed."

And the people of the Divine Dynasty had complicated expressions.

This Wasteland City is really abnormal.

If Ah Wei succeeds, then there will be another sword god in the Wasteland City.

That's a sword god!

Few sword cultivators can go all the way to the end, and they will eventually switch to sword cultivation.

Because there are too few powerful sword cultivators.

There is no way forward to learn from.

It is difficult to achieve anything unless you are a gifted genius.

Just like Ah Wei now.

Even if you have reached the super god realm now, it is still extremely difficult to achieve the god of sword.

But fortunately, Lu Daosheng left some things before he left.

Now, A Wei has entered a critical moment.

In the crowd, a small voice was looking forward nervously.

"Yingying, don't worry, Brother Wei will not be in trouble."

On the side, Luo Li said helplessly.

Hearing this, Fan Yingying said weakly: "I, I'm afraid that he will fail and will be sad."

Looking at Fan Yingying's weak appearance, Luo Li couldn't help but reach out and rub Fan Yingying's little head.

This move immediately made Fan Yingying a little stunned.

A Wei likes to do this.

"Don't worry."

At this time, Yu Qingfeng beside Luo Li suddenly said.

The two turned their heads to look.

"It seems that this brother is really talented. It's the first time I've seen the God of Swords."

Yu Qingfeng smiled lightly.

At this time, everyone looked at him in shock.

I saw a domineering aura pouring out.

Buzz——

A blade of light suddenly broke through the air, instantly splitting the entire void in two.

At the same time, a figure soared into the sky, and the long sword in his hand kept trembling.

At this moment, the terrifying sword intent permeated the heavens, making everyone present feel torn apart.

Is this the God of Sword?

Looking at A Wei holding the divine sword in the void, everyone was moved.

When the people in the deserted city reacted, they cheered.

"God of Sword! God of Sword!!"

"Brother Wei is awesome!"

"The leader is really a role model for our generation!"

At this time, A Wei was also a little excited. At this moment, he recalled the scene when Lu Daosheng first handed the long sword Zhan Tian to him.

At that time, he didn't know the level of Zhan Tian.

Let alone that he would achieve such an achievement now.

Time flies, and he will become the God of Sword admired by the world.

It's really unpredictable.

Thinking of this, Ah Wei suddenly knelt down in the air, kowtowed to the sky and said, "Lord City Lord, please accept my greeting!"
